# ARIEC60870

ARIEC60870 is a free Apache-2.0 Windows desktop protocol evidence analyzer for IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-103, and IEC 60870-5-104 testing.

Canonical site: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/
GitHub repository: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870
Latest release: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/latest
License: Apache-2.0

Primary pages:
- Quick Start: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/quick-start.html
- Protocol Coverage: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/protocol-coverage.html
- Download: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/download.html
- Troubleshooting: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/troubleshooting.html
- FAQ: https://masarray.github.io/ARIEC60870/faq.html

Summary:
The tool runs controlled master/client sessions, decodes IEC 60870 traffic, shows readable engineering evidence, preserves raw TX/RX frame traces, and exports reportable FAT/SAT evidence for commissioning and troubleshooting review.
